Public dev BFF smoke, Steady stack restart-loop check (read-only), advisory functional checks, supplementary read-only QA, acceptance probes: read-only

span.definition: dispatch (run created_at, so runner queue time counts) to the completion (updated_at) of a completed dev Root. All steps above sit inside the three Root jobs and dev-acceptance-stage is the last job, so this is an upper bound on the end of the last service-touching step, with no per-run jobs read
span.N_why: about three days of automatic releases: a slow outlier stays in force long enough to matter, one fast lease-starved or cancelled run cannot lower the maximum, and the value still follows a lasting change in Root duration
span.selection: newest 10 runs of nonprod-deploy.yml with display_title 'Dev release ...', status completed, run_attempt 1 (a rerun's updated_at no longer measures one Root); drills, baseline restores and in-progress runs are ignored
span.statistic: maximum, rounded up to whole minutes
span.fallback_why: no record: the 11/27 worst case of 2h45m (165 min) rounded up with a margin. The workflow job timeouts (6h + 6h + 2h) are not used because they would leave no weekday dispatch slot; the fallback also applies when a record's timestamps are unreadable (it is counted as a candidate)
span.failure: an unreadable run list (request error, malformed payload) gives span None: the hold fails closed with reason root_span_unavailable, no dispatch; the next trigger or hourly fallback retries
span.decision_output: held_quiet_window and dispatched results carry root_span_minutes and root_span_source; the hold also carries reason root_span_inside_window, window, window_ends_at and dispatch_allowed_from (null when no allowed minute exists within 8 days)
span.dispatch_allowed_from: jumps from the end of each window the span reaches to the next candidate, so adjacent windows and day boundaries are exact

budget.detail: one extra list-runs request of nonprod-deploy.yml (per_page 100), made only when a dispatch is ready and quiet windows are configured; no new writer, no new workflow, no new variable, no new blocking functional gate; staging and production unchanged; a running release is still never cancelled
